seo.title: Airbnb: Smart Pricing, dynamic price suggestion to hosts validated in A/B testing (2018)
seo.meta_description: Airbnb suggests a nightly price to hosts through a model combining booking probability and optimal price, deployed in production on Price Tips and Smart Pricing and validated in A/B testing.
seo.resume_citable: Airbnb computes a nightly price for each host with a three-part model (booking probability, optimal price, personalization), deployed in production and validated through A/B testing (KDD 2018).

faq.q: How does Airbnb's Smart Pricing work?
faq.a: A model predicts the booking probability of each night, then an optimal price and a personalization; the host sets bounds and the price adjusts automatically each day.

faq.q: Why does Airbnb not use a classic demand curve?
faq.a: Because no two listings are alike, which makes estimating a standard demand curve impossible; the model works around the problem with a custom loss function.

pattern: dynamic price suggestion to sellers (host pricing)
objectif_business: Help each host set a nightly price that maximizes both booking probability and revenue, across a catalog where no two listings are alike.
description: Price Tips, launched in 2015, suggests a nightly price to the host. Smart Pricing, launched the same year, automatically adjusts the price within the bounds the host sets. The model published at KDD 2018 combines three parts: a classifier that predicts the booking probability of each listing-night, a regression that predicts the optimal price with a custom loss function, and then a personalization layer that produces the final suggestion. The difficulty specific to Airbnb is that no two listings are identical, which prevents estimating a classic demand curve. The model is deployed in production and validated through A/B testing.
points_cles: Dynamic price suggestion to hosts (Price Tips, Smart Pricing).
In-house model in three parts: classifier, regression, personalization.
Deployed in production, effectiveness demonstrated in online A/B testing.
Evidence level B, confirmed active status.

niveau_preuve.justification: Scientific paper published by Airbnb's teams at KDD 2018, describing a production system validated through A/B testing. No public revenue figure isolates the model's effect, hence level B rather than A.

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Daily update of the suggested prices, with automatic adjustment if Smart Pricing is enabled.
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: Airbnb's pricing and data science team for the model, the hosts for the settings.
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: The predicted booking probability per listing-night, crossed with local demand. Without this signal, the price suggestion loses its relevance and the host falls back on a static price.

etapes.detail: A classifier estimates the chance that a listing-night is booked at a given price.
A regression with a custom loss function proposes the price that balances booking and revenue.
A personalization layer adjusts the final suggestion for the listing.
The host sets minimum and maximum price bounds and enables or disables the automatic adjustment.

prerequis_orga: host tool to surface the suggestions
stack_possible: classifier and regression on tabular data
replication.premiere_etape: Build a booking probability model per listing-night before attaching price optimization to it.

playbook.action: Consolidate the booking and price history with local demand signals (seasonality, events).
Train the booking probability classifier and validate it offline.
Attach the price optimization (regression with a tailored loss function) and the personalization layer.
playbook.livrable: Per-night price suggestion validated in backtest

playbook.action: Surface the suggestions in the seller tool with minimum and maximum bounds controlled by the host.
Run an A/B test on a subset of hosts and measure occupancy and revenue.
playbook.livrable: Controlled test result and deployment decision

replication.equipe: 2 pricing data scientists + 1 data engineer + 1 PM on the seller tool side

stack_technique.detail: Airbnb in-house model that predicts the chance a listing-night is booked at a given price.
In-house model that computes the optimal price by balancing booking probability and revenue, published at KDD 2018.
Adjusts the final suggestion to the specific attributes of each listing.
Host tools that surface the suggestion and apply the daily automatic adjustment within the bounds set by the host.

statut_vivant.note: Smart Pricing remains a standard host feature on Airbnb. The model described dates from 2018 and has probably evolved since, but the dynamic price suggestion pattern is still active.

transposable_ue.note: A price suggestion tool for hosts carries over directly; regulatory friction is low because the host keeps control of the price bounds and of activation. GDPR applies to host data but with no particular obstacle.
